---
name: Correction
about: A skill states something stale or wrong about how Upwork works
title: "[correction] "
labels: correction
---

**Which skill and which line?**
Name the skill (e.g. upwork-job-qualifier) and quote the sentence that's wrong.

**What's actually true now?**
Say what changed.

**How do you know?**
A link to Upwork's announcement or docs is best. "It happened on my account on [date]" also counts, describe what you saw.
